note: T4 robustness cases for agent v3 on res31's v1/orange (base: block_1 yellow, block_2 orange, block_3 green, bowl_1 black bowl). Same prompts as presets/orange_robustness.json; expectations mapped to the v3 two-part answer: 'refused' = at least one infeasible entry. Changes after seeing results are flagged in 'changed'.

cases.prompt: put a block somewhere on the table
add a 9 cm red block next to the bowl
cases.why: blocks are 2-6 cm: shrink it or refuse

cases.prompt: add a teapot next to the bowl
the orange block should start inside a drawer
cases.why: block_2 is a locked base object; an alternative (an added orange block in a drawer) may come with the refusal

cases.prompt: add a drawer with two blocks inside, a red one and a blue one; the task is to put the red one in the bowl
cases.changed: 10-29: a cabinet (new in v3) accepted as the drawer

cases.prompt: add a red block next to the blue bowl
cases.changed: 10-29, after the v1 run: also accept adding a blue bowl and placing the block next to it (gpt-oss-20b did that 3/3 on v1; judged a sensible reading, not a failure)

cases.prompt: stack the green block on the yellow block
put the yellow block between the bowl and the orange block
cases.why: no 'between' rule: any valid task on base objects, nothing added
